# Vendored ai-skills scripts

Seven scripts come from ai-skills commit `535591b9094145df94baeb8fa92bf6faba2ebfc8`.
`implementer-core/scripts/collect_evidence.sh` comes from ai-skills commit
`77a2def903cd7989106a6b189ded8cb30fd2ffb5` (Git blob `6eb168748aed016d33caa27447dd5a94442079d1`).

To refresh, copy the scripts from their chosen ai-skills revisions into the mirrored
directories, retain executable mode 0755, update the recorded revisions, and run the tests.
These files are distributed under herder's MIT OR Apache-2.0 license.
